# Cab Castle Goa — Cab & Tour Travel Service Information
> Premium Cab Rental & Tour Travel Provider in Goa, India.

## Business Summary
Cab Castle Goa offers premium cabs and tour packages across North Goa and South Goa with transparent hourly packages (8 hours / 80 km), fixed point-to-point airport and railway station transfers, and 24/7 on-ground dispatch support.

## Key Fleet Offerings & Hourly Packages (8 hrs / 80 km)
- Sedan (Maruti Dzire / Hyundai Aura): ₹2,500/day | Extra hr: ₹250 | Extra km: ₹25 | Night charge: ₹500
- Ertiga (7-Seater MPV): ₹3,000/day | Extra hr: ₹250 | Extra km: ₹25 | Night charge: ₹500
- Innova (Toyota Innova Crysta): ₹3,500/day | Extra hr: ₹250 | Extra km: ₹25 | Night charge: ₹500

## Point-to-Point Transfers (Per Vehicle)
- Airport Pickup / Drop (Mopa GOX / Dabolim GOI): Sedan ₹1,300 | Ertiga ₹1,600 | Innova ₹2,200
- Margao Railway Station: Sedan ₹1,500 | Ertiga ₹1,800 | Innova ₹2,000
- Thivim Railway Station: Sedan ₹1,100 | Ertiga ₹1,400 | Innova ₹1,600

## Pickup & Delivery Hubs
- Main Operations Hub: Assagao, Bardez, North Goa 403507
- 24/7 Cab Dispatch across Candolim, Calangute, Baga, Panaji, Anjuna
- 24/7 Airport Meet-and-Greet at Dabolim (GOI) and Mopa (GOX)
